findings.symptom: The intended empty-diagram / +1-unknot figure is not rendered; literal TikZ source is printed in the ItemBody below the explanatory caption.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair the local TikZ rendering or replace the block with a supported diagram representation; preserve the two panels and +1 framing label.

findings.symptom: The renderer displays a red “diagram failed to render” box in place of the intended merge-saddle schematic.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair the TikZ syntax or replace with a supported diagram. Draw two incoming level-set circles connected by the saddle band and one outgoing circle; label the arrow “one saddle band”. Keep it explicitly a merge example.

findings.symptom: The three-case epsilon display visually collides with the following explanatory sentence (“Here zero and nonzero…”), making the cases difficult to read.
findings.suggested_repair: Separate the cases into a properly displayed aligned/cases environment with enough vertical spacing before the explanatory sentence.

findings.symptom: The long nested triangle-count formula is rendered in an extremely compressed, crowded display; its index conditions and sum factors are hard to distinguish at the captured width.
findings.suggested_repair: Break the triangle-map expression into aligned lines, placing the admissibility conditions below or beside the inner sum without compressing the whole expression.

findings.symptom: The local crossing and smoothing diagrams render, but the captions/weights at their lower edges overlap one another and the figure is too compressed to distinguish the three labels reliably.
findings.suggested_repair: Increase the diagram scale or separate each label from its drawing with more vertical space; keep the crossing, A/B smoothing pairings, and weights A and A^{-1} distinct.

findings.symptom: A red “diagram failed to render” box replaces the forward-surgery / reverse-surgery correspondence diagram.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair the tikzcd block or use a supported simple arrow diagram: S^3 → Y → S^3, labeled forward surgery and reverse surgery.

findings.symptom: The clasp diagram is not rendered; its literal TikZ commands appear as plain source text in the ItemBody.
findings.suggested_repair: Repair the TikZ rendering or replace with a supported diagram. Preserve the two oriented mixed crossings between a_i^+ (blue) and a_j (red), with a_i^+ over at the left and a_j over at the right, both positive.

existing_diagram_checks: The braid-closure and trefoil/unknot schematics, Reidemesiter-I local pair, blackboard push-off crossing pair, and twisted-Burau filling square were reviewed in their assigned tiles and were not recorded as defects.
Known failed or raw-source TikZ blocks are recorded above as confirmed rendering defects.

candidate_diagrams.claim: At a diagram crossing with source under-arc u, target under-arc v, and overarc o, the coloring relation is x_v=x_u*x_o; reversing source and target uses the inverse operation.
candidate_diagrams.why_warranted: The definition assigns labels to three local strands and uses the crossing orientation to determine which under-arc label changes. A small crossing chart would make the source/target and overarc convention directly checkable.
candidate_diagrams.specific_content: Draw one oriented overpassing strand labeled o and an underpassing strand with source arc u entering and target arc v leaving. Show the crossing normal/orientation convention used by the linked diagram-coloring definition, label the rack relation x_v=x_u*x_o, and indicate that reversing the traversal gives the barred operation. Avoid implying the overarc changes color.

visual_observations.raw_ascii_math_findings: No independent literal ASCII caret/underscore math defect was confirmed. Literal TikZ source is visible for cex-knot-kt-14-boundary-case and lem-integral-seifert-form-is-realized-by-a-knot; see findings.
visual_observations.reference_title_link_lines: Wikilinks render as separate block lines in facts/reference lists; this is expected and was not classified as a defect.
visual_observations.technique_banner_case: Uppercase technique banners are intended styling; none was reported on case alone.
visual_observations.clipping: No independent clipping finding confirmed. All tiles were read individually at original resolution; consecutive tiles overlap by capture design.
visual_observations.existing_diagram_math: Existing visible diagrams were checked against their captions and local orientation/map conventions; correct existing figures are coverage, not findings.
